claims.explanation: JNJ-26481585 (quisinostat) is a pan-HDAC inhibitor whose selectivity likely reflects dependence on class I HDAC activity and intact apoptotic machinery, particularly p53-mediated apoptosis and mitochondrial injury, as shown in lung cancer cells. Lines with high HDAC1/2/3 expression or p53 pathway activation would be more sensitive, while those with protective lesions in apoptosis or DNA repair may resist. The transcriptional similarity to caspase activators and cytarabine supports a mechanism involving DNA damage/apoptosis rather than a single lineage-specific driver.
